newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai Baht float pressures Singapore rubber futures.
newsitem.headline: Thai Baht float pressures Singapore rubber futures.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower on Thursday on continued selling interest, pressured by Wednesday's float of the Thai Baht, brokers said.

"Market sentiment hasn't changed. It's too early to tell if the float of the Thai Baht will have a lasting effect. Trading looks a little thin today, but it will probably take a few days for traders to sort out prices," a local broker said.

"There's still some pressure from the Thai currency devaluation yesterday. Sentiment is very bearish and prices are not stable because there's too much supply and not much demand," another local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, August RSS3 fell 1.50 cents to 91.50 U.S. cents a kg.
September RSS1 fell one cent to 136.75 Singapore cents (96 U.S. cents) a kg.
December TSR20 FOB fell 0.25 cents to 98.75 U.S. cents a kg.
